title: Help exit code and channel
description: The sources require help text but state no response contract for it. Options weighed: exit 0 with help on stdout, or exit 2 with help on stderr. Help is a requested output, not a failure, so exit 0 on stdout is the conventional narrowest choice.

options.label: help is a usage error on stderr, exit 2

title: Repeated options
description: The sources do not say what happens when an option is given twice. Rejecting is the narrowest behavior consistent with 'malformed value' usage errors; last-wins would silently accept ambiguity.

options.label: Repeated option is a usage error (exit 2)

title: Radius comparison precision
description: The radius filter compares the unrounded haversine distance with --radius, then rounds only for display, since the sources define the filter as 'distance at most radius' and formatting separately.

title: FeatureCollection without a features array or with malformed features
description: A document with type FeatureCollection but no features array is an operational failure (exit 1) per the reading rules. A feature lacking required fields other than a null mag is likewise treated as an operational failure rather than skipped.
